findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Jayrald Tajanlangit" above "Full-stack and mobile systems, from scre"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (IBM Plex Sans, Newsreader, Arial).
No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Libre Franklin and Source Serif 4, but the page renders IBM Plex Sans, Newsreader.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 0px from the left edge but only to 160px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 726px of the width empty: "Full-stack and mobile systems,".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1708px at 27896px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The h1 ("Full-stack and mobile systems, from screen to stat") is not on the first screen (it starts 12905px down).
findings.fix: The title belongs on the first screen, where a visitor decides whether to stay.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "mAIstra · Open a submission" (0px from the left); "Bulk Buying Companion · Browse" (0px from the left); "Sige · Tasks UI prototype" (0px from the left); "mAIstra · Review the code" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Full-stack and mobile systems, from screen to st" → 3 lines (8 words, 32.1px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
